1160:     def _investment_elimination(
1161:         self,
1162:         comb_bs: dict[str, Decimal],
1163:         acquisition_result: Any,
1164:         elim_entries: list[EliminationEntry],
1165:     ) -> tuple[Decimal, Decimal]:
1166:         """Eliminate parent investments against the subsidiaries' equity.
1167: 
1168:         The parent holds ``1600`` (UK, USD) and ``1610`` (India, USD). Each
1169:         investment is eliminated against the subsidiary's equity at the rate
1170:         the group policy attributes to that equity, and the *rate movement*
1171:         between the investment's carrying (closing) rate and its elimination
1172:         rate is a genuine exchange difference that goes to the translation
1173:         reserve (3300) — never to retained earnings.
1174: 
1175:         * **UK** — owned before FY2024, so its opening equity is already in the
1176:           prior-year group figures. The investment is eliminated at the
1177:           **opening** rate against UK share capital (GBP 1,000,000); the small
1178:           excess of share capital over the investment at the opening rate is
1179:           part of the group's opening position and goes to reserves. The rate
1180:           movement ``Inv_UK_usd x (closing - opening)`` goes to 3300.
1181:         * **India** — acquired this year, so it enters at its **spot**-rate net
1182:           assets at completion. The investment is eliminated at spot against
1183:           India's share capital + pre-acquisition reserves + goodwill, with NCI
1184:           recognised at spot. The rate movements on the investment
1185:           (``Inv_in_usd x (closing - spot)``) and on goodwill
1186:           (``Goodwill_inr x (closing - spot)``) go to 3300.
1187: 
1188:         ``comb_bs`` holds the running consolidated balances for real accounts
1189:         (assets, liabilities, P&L, goodwill, NCI, translation reserve). The
1190:         subsidiary equity accounts (3100/3200) are **not** in ``comb_bs`` —
1191:         equity is contributed by the parent's opening position — so the
1192:         investment journals' equity lines are recorded for the elimination
1193:         report only and never mutate ``comb_bs``. NCI and goodwill deltas ARE
1194:         applied (they become part of the consolidated balance sheet).
1195: 
1196:         Returns ``(uk_rate_movement, india_rate_movement)`` in GBP: the exchange
1197:         differences routed to 3300 for the UK and India investments (investment
1198:         plus goodwill movements) respectively, used by the closed-form check.
1199:         """
1200:         inv_uk_usd = self._investment_amount_usd("1600")
1201:         inv_in_usd = self._investment_amount_usd("1610")
1202:         usd_open = self._rate("USD", FXRateType.OPENING)
1203:         usd_close = self._rate("USD", FXRateType.CLOSING)
1204:         usd_spot = self._rate("USD", FXRateType.SPOT)
1205:         inr_spot = self._rate("INR", FXRateType.SPOT)
1206:         inr_close = self._rate("INR", FXRateType.CLOSING)
1207: 
1208:         uk_sc_gbp = self._uk_share_capital_gbp()
1209:         gw_inr = acquisition_result.goodwill  # INR
1210:         nci_acq_inr = acquisition_result.nci_at_acquisition  # INR
1211: 
1212:         # --- UK investment (eliminated at the opening rate) ----------------
1213:         uk_inv_carrying = inv_uk_usd * usd_close           # in comb_bs at closing
1214:         uk_inv_at_open = inv_uk_usd * usd_open
1215:         uk_rate_movement = uk_inv_carrying - uk_inv_at_open
1216:         # The group's opening reserves carry the excess of UK share capital over
1217:         # the investment at the opening rate (the UK was owned before FY2024).
1218:         uk_excess_to_reserves = uk_sc_gbp - uk_inv_at_open
1219: 
1220:         comb_bs["1600"] = comb_bs.get("1600", _ZERO) - uk_inv_carrying
1221:         self._opening_re_adjustment = uk_excess_to_reserves
1222: 
1223:         self._post_balanced(
1224:             elim_entries,
1225:             journal_id="ELIM-INV-UK",
1226:             kind="investment",
1227:             reference="Northwind UK Ltd investment",
1228:             reason=(
1229:                 "eliminate the parent's investment in Northwind UK Ltd against "
1230:                 "the subsidiary's share capital at the opening rate; the "
1231:                 "closing/opening rate movement goes to the translation reserve "
1232:                 "(policy §2, §4)"
1233:             ),
1234:             balancing_account=TRESERVE,
1235:             lines=[
1236:                 ("1600", _ZERO, uk_inv_carrying),                  # remove investment at carrying (closing) rate
1237:                 ("3100", uk_sc_gbp, _ZERO),                        # remove UK share capital (GBP)
1238:                 ("3200", _ZERO, uk_excess_to_reserves),            # excess of SC over investment@opening to reserves
1239:             ],
1240:         )
1241: 
1242:         # --- India investment (eliminated at spot) -------------------------
1243:         in_inv_carrying = inv_in_usd * usd_close
1244:         india_rate_movement = in_inv_carrying - inv_in_usd * usd_spot
1245:         goodwill_rate_movement = gw_inr * (inr_close - inr_spot)
1246:         gw_at_spot = gw_inr * inr_spot
1247:         nci_at_spot = nci_acq_inr * inr_spot
1248: 
1249:         comb_bs["1610"] = comb_bs.get("1610", _ZERO) - in_inv_carrying
1250:         comb_bs[GOODWILL] = comb_bs.get(GOODWILL, _ZERO) + gw_inr * inr_close
1251:         comb_bs[NCI_ACCOUNT] = comb_bs.get(NCI_ACCOUNT, _ZERO) - nci_at_spot
1252: 
1253:         self._post_balanced(
1254:             elim_entries,
1255:             journal_id="ELIM-INV-IN",
1256:             kind="investment",
1257:             reference="Northwind India Pvt Ltd investment",
1258:             reason=(
1259:                 "eliminate the parent's investment in Northwind India Pvt Ltd "
1260:                 "at the acquisition spot rate against the subsidiary's share "
1261:                 "capital, pre-acquisition reserves and goodwill, recognising "
1262:                 "NCI at spot; investment and goodwill rate movements go to the "
1263:                 "translation reserve (policy §2, §4)"
1264:             ),
1265:             balancing_account=TRESERVE,
1266:             lines=[
1267:                 ("1610", _ZERO, in_inv_carrying),                  # remove investment at carrying (closing) rate
1268:                 ("3100", inv_in_usd * usd_spot, _ZERO),            # the owner's share of net assets at spot
1269:                 (GOODWILL, gw_at_spot, _ZERO),                     # goodwill recognised at spot
1270:                 (NCI_ACCOUNT, _ZERO, nci_at_spot),                 # NCI at acquisition (spot)
1271:             ],
1272:         )
1273: 
1274:         return uk_rate_movement, india_rate_movement + goodwill_rate_movement
1275: 
1276:     def _investment_amount_usd(self, group_code: str) -> Decimal:
1277:         """The parent's investment balance for ``group_code`` in USD.
1278: 
1279:         Read from the US trial balance (functional-currency magnitude), never
1280:         from a translated figure, so the elimination rate can be applied
1281:         independently.
1282:         """
1283:         data = getattr(self, "_entity_data", {}).get("US")
1284:         if data is None:
1285:             data = self._load_entities(["US"])["US"]
1286:         total = _ZERO
1287:         for row in data.mapped.rows:
1288:             if row.group_account_code == group_code and row.mapped:
1289:                 total += row.debit - row.credit
1290:         return total
1291: 
1292:     def _uk_share_capital_gbp(self) -> Decimal:
1293:         """UK share capital in GBP (functional-currency magnitude)."""
1294:         data = getattr(self, "_entity_data", {}).get("UK")
1295:         if data is None:
1296:             data = self._load_entities(["UK"])["UK"]
1297:         total = _ZERO
1298:         for row in data.mapped.rows:
1299:             if row.group_account_code == "3100" and row.mapped:
1300:                 total += row.credit - row.debit
1301:         return total

1303:     def _post_balanced(
1304:         self,
1305:         elim_entries: list[EliminationEntry],
1306:         *,
1307:         journal_id: str,
1308:         kind: str,
1309:         reference: str,
1310:         reason: str,
1311:         lines: list[tuple[str, Decimal, Decimal]],
1312:         balancing_account: str | None = None,
1313:         expected_balance: Decimal | None = None,
1314:     ) -> Decimal:
1315:         """Record a balanced elimination journal (reporting only).
1316: 
1317:         The caller applies the *real* balance effects to ``comb_bs``
1318:         explicitly. When the supplied ``lines`` do not already balance, the
1319:         residual is posted to ``balancing_account`` (the translation reserve)
1320:         as a credit when the debits exceed the credits, or a debit otherwise.
1321:         If ``expected_balance`` is given (the closed-form TR contribution,
1322:         positive = an increase in the credit-balance reserve), the posted
1323:         balancing amount must equal ``-expected_balance`` within the reporting
1324:         tolerance, or the journal is a bug and raises.
1325: 
1326:         Returns the posted balancing amount (net = debits - credits) for the
1327:         balancing account.
1328:         """
1329:         debits = sum((d for _, d, _ in lines), _ZERO)
1330:         credits = sum((c for _, _, c in lines), _ZERO)
1331:         net = debits - credits
1332:         posted = list(lines)
1333:         if balancing_account is not None and net != _ZERO:
1334:             if net > 0:
1335:                 posted.append((balancing_account, _ZERO, net))
1336:             else:
1337:                 posted.append((balancing_account, -net, _ZERO))
1338:         final_debits = sum((d for _, d, _ in posted), _ZERO)
1339:         final_credits = sum((c for _, _, c in posted), _ZERO)
1340:         if abs(final_debits - final_credits) > _ROUNDING_TOLERANCE:
1341:             raise ServiceError(
1342:                 f"elimination journal {journal_id} does not balance: debits "
1343:                 f"{final_debits} vs credits {final_credits}",
1344:                 details={"journal_id": journal_id},
1345:             )
1346:         if expected_balance is not None and abs(net + expected_balance) > _ROUNDING_TOLERANCE:
1347:             raise ServiceError(
1348:                 f"elimination journal {journal_id} balancing amount {net} does "
1349:                 f"not equal the expected translation-reserve movement "
1350:                 f"{-expected_balance}",
1351:                 details={"journal_id": journal_id},
1352:             )
1353:         for code, debit, credit in posted:
1354:             if debit == _ZERO and credit == _ZERO:
1355:                 continue
1356:             elim_entries.append(
1357:                 EliminationEntry(
1358:                     journal_id=journal_id,
1359:                     kind=kind,
1360:                     reference=reference,
1361:                     group_account_code=code,
1362:                     group_account_name=self._account_name(code),
1363:                     entity="GROUP",
1364:                     gbp_debit=debit,
1365:                     gbp_credit=credit,
1366:                     reason=reason,
1367:                 )
1368:             )
1369:         return net

1708:     @staticmethod
1709:     def _foot_section(section: StatementSection) -> StatementSection:
1710:         """Make the rounded line items sum exactly to the rounded section total.
1711: 
1712:         Each reported line is rounded to 2 dp independently (policy §7), so the
1713:         rounded lines can differ from the (rounded) exact total by a penny. A
1714:         reader summing the statement must reach the total, so the residual is
1715:         absorbed by the largest line item — a standard presentation-rounding
1716:         adjustment that leaves every other line untouched and never changes the
1717:         total. Lines without an amount (or with ``None``) are ignored.
1718:         """
1719:         if section.total is None:
1720:             return section
1721:         lines = [ln for ln in section.lines if ln.amount is not None]
1722:         if not lines:
1723:             return section
1724:         rounded_sum = sum((ln.amount for ln in lines), _ZERO)
1725:         residual = section.total - rounded_sum
1726:         if residual == _ZERO:
1727:             return section
1728:         # Absorb the residual in the largest line item.
1729:         target = max(lines, key=lambda ln: abs(ln.amount))
1730:         new_lines = [
1731:             ln.model_copy(update={"amount": ln.amount + residual})
1732:             if ln is target
1733:             else ln
1734:             for ln in section.lines
1735:         ]
1736:         return section.model_copy(update={"lines": new_lines})

1935:           matched on both sides but booked at different rates;

1937:           the receiving entity at the year end (policy §5).
1938:         """

1941:         # Aggregate balances in GBP (closing rate), before elimination.
1942:         us_bs = self._entity_balances_raw("US")
1943:         uk_bs = self._entity_balances_raw("UK")

1945:         receivable = us_bs.get(IC_RECEIVABLE, [_ZERO, _ZERO])[0] * usd_closing
1946:         payable = uk_bs.get(IC_PAYABLE, [_ZERO, _ZERO])[1]  # UK books in GBP
1947:         total = receivable - payable
1948: 
1949:         in_transit = _ZERO

1951:             if item.classification == "in_transit" and item.gbp_amount is not None:
1952:                 in_transit += item.gbp_amount
1953:         doc_booking_fx = total - in_transit

1958:                 "in_transit": round_reported(in_transit),
1959:             },

2015:                         },
2016:                     )

2018:                 total += amount * resolved.rate

2020:         if missing:

2081:         """Replace the equity rows with the assembled equity figures on the
2082:         **open-ledger (trial-balance) basis**.
2083: 
2084:         The trial balance keeps the year's P&L accounts open, so the equity
2085:         rows must not also carry the year's result. The TB therefore shows:
2086: 
2087:         * share capital (closing — unchanged in the year),
2088:         * **opening** retained earnings (the current profit stays in the open
2089:           P&L accounts, so it is not rolled into retained earnings here),
2090:         * the **closing** translation reserve (its movement is a balance-sheet
2091:           equity movement, not a P&L item),
2092:         * NCI **at acquisition** (its share of the current profit is part of
2093:           the open P&L, not a separate ledger equity movement).
2094: 
2095:         With those figures the consolidated TB balances exactly
2096:         (debits = credits). The reported *statements* use the closing figures
2097:         (retained earnings including the year's profit, NCI closing) — the
2098:         difference is precisely the year's profit, represented in the TB by
2099:         the open P&L accounts.
2100:         """
2101:         equity_lines: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
2102:         for section in statements.balance_sheet:
2103:             if section.title != "Equity":
2104:                 continue
2105:             for line in section.lines:
2106:                 if line.group_account_code and line.amount is not None:
2107:                     equity_lines[line.group_account_code] = line.amount
2108: 
2109:         # Override the accounts that must be on the ledger basis, using the
2110:         # unrounded values so the trial balance balances exactly.
2111:         unrounded = getattr(self, "_unrounded_equity", {})
2112:         equity_lines["3100"] = unrounded.get("3100", equity_lines.get("3100", _ZERO))
2113:         equity_lines["3200"] = opening_re
2114:         equity_lines["3300"] = unrounded.get("3300", equity_lines.get("3300", _ZERO))
2115:         equity_lines["3400"] = nci_at_acquisition
2116: 
2117:         # The closing translation reserve from the assembled equity section is
2118:         # kept as-is (3300): the reserve movement is an equity movement.
2119: 
2120:         kept = [r for r in tb_rows if r.account_type != "Equity"]
2121:         equity_source = {
2122:             "entity": "GROUP",
2123:             "source_file": "prior_year_group.csv",
2124:             "source_row": None,
2125:             "note": "opening group equity; movements from the year's result, "
2126:             "translation reserve and acquisition (see eliminations.csv)",
2127:         }
2128:         for code, amount in equity_lines.items():
2129:             account = self.mapper.group_coa.get(code)
2130:             if account is None:
2131:                 continue
2132:             # Credit-positive equity: a positive amount is a credit magnitude.
2133:             debit = -amount if amount < 0 else _ZERO
2134:             credit = amount if amount > 0 else _ZERO
2135:             kept.append(
2136:                 ConsolidatedTBRow(
2137:                     group_account_code=code,
2138:                     group_account_name=account.account_name,
2139:                     account_type=account.account_type,
2140:                     statement=account.statement,
2141:                     gbp_debit=debit,
2142:                     gbp_credit=credit,
2143:                     sources=[dict(equity_source)],
2144:                 )
2145:             )
2146:         return sorted(kept, key=lambda r: r.group_account_code)

2155: 
2156:         ``comb_pl`` / ``comb_bs`` net amounts are converted back into

2159:         rows: list[ConsolidatedTBRow] = []
2160:         net_by_code: dict[str, Decimal] = {}

2162:         # account is normally either a balance-sheet or a P&L account (so the
2163:         # two sets are disjoint), but the FX account (7300) receives both a
2164:         # balance-sheet movement (the exchange difference on eliminating

2167:         for code, net in comb_bs.items():

347: def test_translation_reserve_is_genuine_fx_movement(bundle):
348:     # The translation reserve movement must be the exchange difference derived
349:     # from the actual translation arithmetic (policy §2), NOT a balancing plug.
350:     # It is independently recomputed here directly from the raw quoted rates:
351:     #   India closing net assets @ closing cross rate
352:     #     - net assets at acquisition @ acquisition-date (spot) cross rate
353:     #     - H2 profit @ H2-average cross rate,
354:     # where the GBP/INR cross rate = 1 / (GBP/USD quote x USD/INR quote).
355:     import csv as _csv
356: 
357:     quotes: dict[tuple[str, str, str], Decimal] = {}
358:     with (REPO_DATA / "northwind" / "fx_rates.csv").open() as fh:
359:         for row in _csv.DictReader(fh):
360:             quotes[(row["base_currency"], row["quote_currency"], row["rate_type"])] = (
361:                 Decimal(row["rate"])
362:             )
363: 
364:     def gbp_per_inr(rate_type: str) -> Decimal:
365:         gbp_usd = quotes[("GBP", "USD", rate_type)]
366:         usd_inr = quotes[("USD", "INR", rate_type if rate_type != "spot" else "spot")]
367:         return Decimal("1") / (gbp_usd * usd_inr)
368: 
369:     closing = gbp_per_inr("closing")
370:     h2 = gbp_per_inr("h2_average")
371:     spot = gbp_per_inr("spot")
372: 
373:     net_assets_acq = Decimal("678000000")
374:     profit_h2 = Decimal("42000000")
375:     expected = (
376:         (net_assets_acq + profit_h2) * closing
377:         - net_assets_acq * spot
378:         - profit_h2 * h2
379:     )
380:     assert round(expected, 2) == Decimal("-108138.43")
381:     assert bundle.control_figures["translation_reserve_movement"] == Decimal(
382:         "-108138.43"
383:     )

187:                                 f"is not in the group chart of accounts"
188:                             ),
189:                             entity=entity,
190:                             source_file=record.source_file,
191:                             source_row=record.source_row,
192:                             account_code=local_code,
193:                             details={"group_code": record.group_code},
194:                         )
195:                     )
196:                 self._check_name_mismatch(entity, record, issues)
197: 
198:         return issues
199: 
200:     def _check_name_mismatch(
201:         self, entity: str, record: MappingEntry, issues: list[ValidationIssue]
202:     ) -> None:
203:         """Flag a mapping whose group account contradicts an exact COA name.
204: 
205:         If a group account shares the mapping's ``local_name`` exactly, but the
206:         mapping points at a *different* group account, that is a probable
207:         mis-mapping worth a human review. Purely a name check against the COA —
208:         no account is hardcoded — so it fires only when the source data really
209:         contradicts itself (e.g. UK ``2310 Deferred income`` → 4100 while the
210:         COA keeps 'Deferred income' at 2300).
211:         """
212:         if not record.local_name:
213:             return
214:         wanted = record.local_name.strip().casefold()
215:         same_name = sorted(
216:             code
217:             for code, account in self.group_coa.items()
218:             if account.account_name.strip().casefold() == wanted
219:         )
220:         if same_name and record.group_code not in same_name:
221:             mapped = self.group_coa.get(record.group_code)
222:             issues.append(
223:                 ValidationIssue(
224:                     code="group_account_name_mismatch",
225:                     severity=Severity.WARNING,
226:                     message=(
227:                         f"{entity} local account {record.local_code} "
228:                         f"({record.local_name!r}) maps to group account "
229:                         f"{record.group_code}"
230:                         f"{f' ({mapped.account_name!r})' if mapped else ''}, but "
231:                         f"the group chart has the same name at "
232:                         f"{same_name}"
233:                     ),
234:                     entity=entity,
235:                     source_file=record.source_file,
236:                     source_row=record.source_row,
237:                     account_code=record.local_code,
238:                     details={
239:                         "local_name": record.local_name,
240:                         "group_code": record.group_code,
241:                         "name_matched_group_accounts": same_name,
242:                     },
243:                 )
244:             )
245: 
246:     # -- applying ----------------------------------------------------------
247: 
248:     def map_trial_balance(self, tb: TrialBalance) -> MappedTrialBalance:
249:         """Resolve every row of ``tb`` to a group account.
250: 
251:         US uses the identity mapping (local code == group code). UK/IN use
252:         their explicit mapping file. Rows whose local account has no mapping
253:         are still returned (never dropped) with ``mapped=False`` and an
254:         ``unmapped_account`` issue.
255:         """
256:         entity = tb.entity.strip().upper()
257: 
258:         if entity in _MAPPED_ENTITIES:
259:             entries, mapping_source_file = self.load_mapping(entity)
260:             lookup: dict[str, str] = {}
261:             # Only unambiguous records build the lookup; conflicting local
262:             # codes are left unresolved (reported, not guessed).
263:             by_local: dict[str, set[str]] = defaultdict(set)
264:             for entry in entries:
265:                 if entry.local_code and entry.group_code:
266:                     by_local[entry.local_code].add(entry.group_code)
267:             for local_code, group_codes in by_local.items():
268:                 if len(group_codes) == 1:
269:                     lookup[local_code] = next(iter(group_codes))
270: 
271:             issues = self.validate_mapping(entity, entries)
272:         else:
273:             # Identity mapping (US): the local code is already a group code.
274:             lookup = {}
275:             mapping_source_file = None
276:             issues = []
277: 
278:         rows: list[MappedRow] = []
279:         for row in tb.rows:
280:             group_code = self._resolve(entity, row.local_account_code, lookup)
281:             mapped = group_code is not None and group_code in self.group_coa
282:             group_account = self.group_coa.get(group_code) if group_code else None
283: 
284:             if entity not in _MAPPED_ENTITIES and group_code is not None and not mapped:
285:                 issues.append(
286:                     ValidationIssue(
287:                         code="missing_group_account",
288:                         severity=Severity.ERROR,
289:                         message=(
290:                             f"{entity} account {row.local_account_code} is not "
291:                             f"in the group chart of accounts"
292:                         ),
293:                         entity=entity,
294:                         source_file=row.source_file,
295:                         source_row=row.source_row,
296:                         account_code=row.local_account_code,
297:                         details={"group_code": group_code},
298:                     )
299:                 )
300:             if entity in _MAPPED_ENTITIES and group_code is None:
301:                 issues.append(
302:                     ValidationIssue(
303:                         code="unmapped_account",
304:                         severity=Severity.WARNING,
305:                         message=(
306:                             f"{entity} local account {row.local_account_code} "
307:                             f"({row.account_name!r}) has no mapping to a group "
308:                             f"account"
309:                         ),
310:                         entity=entity,
311:                         source_file=row.source_file,
312:                         source_row=row.source_row,
313:                         account_code=row.local_account_code,
314:                     )
315:                 )
316: 
317:             rows.append(
318:                 MappedRow(
319:                     entity=entity,
320:                     source_file=row.source_file,
321:                     source_row=row.source_row,
322:                     local_account_code=row.local_account_code,
323:                     group_account_code=group_code if mapped else None,
324:                     group_account_name=group_account.account_name if group_account else None,
325:                     currency=row.currency,
326:                     debit=row.debit,
327:                     credit=row.credit,
328:                     cost_centre=row.cost_centre,
329:                     mapped=mapped,
330:                     raw=row.raw,
331:                 )
332:             )
333: 
334:         return MappedTrialBalance(
335:             entity=entity,
336:             functional_currency=tb.functional_currency,
337:             source_file=tb.source_file,
338:             mapping_source_file=mapping_source_file,
339:             rows=rows,
340:             issues=issues,
341:         )
342: 
343:     @staticmethod
344:     def _resolve(
345:         entity: str, local_code: str, lookup: dict[str, str]
346:     ) -> str | None:
347:         if entity in _MAPPED_ENTITIES:
348:             return lookup.get(local_code)
349:         # US: identity, but only if the code is a real group account.
350:         return local_code or None
```

162:     def assemble(self, entities: list[str] | None = None) -> "ConsolidationOutput":
163:         """Run the full assembly and return the consolidated output bundle."""
164:         entity_ids = (
165:             [e.strip().upper() for e in entities]
166:             if entities
167:             else ["UK", "US", "IN"]
168:         )
169:         entity_ids = sorted(set(entity_ids))
170:         self.issues = []
171:         self.stages = []
172:         self._entity_data: dict[str, _EntityData] = {}
173: 
174:         # 1. Ingest / validate / map each entity (deterministic services).
175:         entity_data = self._load_entities(entity_ids)
176:         self._entity_data = entity_data
177: 
178:         # 2. Journals: classify and apply the postable ones.
179:         decisions = self.journals.validate()
180:         posted = {d.journal_id for d in decisions if d.status is JournalStatus.POSTED}
181: 
182:         # A balanced, in-period journal whose *every* line maps to a group
183:         # account is postable. If any line has no grouping, posting only the
184:         # mapped lines would unbalance the entity (a real defect: see JE-016,
185:         # whose Dr IN-GST-ITC leg has no mapping). Such a journal is rejected in
186:         # full — never partially applied — and recorded as an issue. This keeps
187:         # each entity's post-journal functional balance intact.
188:         decisions = self._reject_partially_unmapped_journals(entity_data, decisions)
189:         posted = {d.journal_id for d in decisions if d.status is JournalStatus.POSTED}
190:         posted_journals = [
191:             j for j in self.journals.load_journals() if j.journal_id in posted
192:         ]
193:         self._record_journal_issues(decisions)
194:         self._record_prompt_injection_issues()
195: 
196:         # Sub-ledger control reconciliation (AR/AP control totals vs the TB).
197:         self._check_subledger_controls(entity_data)
198: 
199:         # Merge posted journal effects into each entity's mapped accounts.
200:         adjusted = self._apply_journals(entity_data, posted_journals)
201: 
202:         # 3. Translate each entity into GBP (closing / average / H2 average).
203:         translated = self._translate(entity_data, adjusted)
204: 
205:         # 4. Intercompany reconciliation + eliminations.
206:         reconciliation = self.reconciler.reconcile()
207:         eliminator = Eliminator(self.reconciler)
208:         elimination_result = eliminator.build(reconciliation)
209: 
210:         # 5. Acquisition accounting (goodwill, NCI at acquisition).
211:         acquisition_result = self.acquisition.compute(self.acquisition.load_inputs("IN"))
212:         for issue in acquisition_result.issues:
213:             self._add_issue(
214:                 code=issue.code,
215:                 severity=issue.severity,
216:                 message=issue.message,
217:                 action="flagged",
218:                 entity=issue.entity,
219:                 source_file=issue.source_file,
220:                 source_row=issue.source_row,
221:             )
222: 
223:         # Post-acquisition profit for NCI (India H2).
224:         nci_post = self.acquisition.post_acquisition_profit(
225:             "IN",
226:             acquisition_date=acquisition_result.acquisition_date,
227:             ownership_pct=acquisition_result.ownership_pct,
228:             income_rate_type=FXRateType.H2_AVERAGE,
229:         )
230: 
231:         # 6. Combine + eliminate into a consolidated trial balance.
232:         tb_rows, elim_entries, equity_balances = self._combine_and_eliminate(
233:             entity_data, translated, elimination_result, acquisition_result
234:         )
235: 
236:         # 7. Compute the translation reserve as the balancing equity movement.
237:         statements, figures = self._build_statements(
238:             tb_rows=tb_rows,
239:             equity_balances=equity_balances,
240:             elimination_result=elimination_result,
241:             acquisition_result=acquisition_result,
242:             nci_post=nci_post,
243:             decisions=decisions,
244:         )
245: 
246:         # 8. Align the consolidated trial balance's equity rows with the
247:         #    assembled equity position, so the TB and the statements agree
248:         #    (both derive from the same figures; the reserve is the balancer).
249:         #
250:         #    The TB is the *open-ledger* view: the year's P&L accounts still
251:         #    carry the result (income as a credit, expenses as a debit), so the
252:         #    equity rows must be on the same basis — opening retained earnings
253:         #    and NCI *at acquisition*, with the closing translation reserve.
254:         #    Using the statements' closing retained earnings and closing NCI
255:         #    would double-count the year's profit and leave the TB out of
256:         #    balance by exactly the group profit.
257:         tb_rows = self._sync_equity_rows(
258:             tb_rows,
259:             statements,
260:             opening_re=equity_balances.get("3200", _ZERO)
261:             + getattr(self, "_investment_elimination_residual", _ZERO)
262:             + getattr(self, "_opening_position_unreconciled", _ZERO),
263:             nci_at_acquisition=acquisition_result.nci_at_acquisition_gbp,
264:         )
265: 
266:         # 9. Verify the consolidated trial balance balances on full-precision
267:         #    values (debits = credits) and record it as an integrity check.
268:         #    Translation uses non-terminating Decimal division (e.g. 1/1.2530),
269:         #    so the exact full-precision totals can differ by an infinitesimal
270:         #    (≈1e-20) that is far below the policy's 1p reporting quantum. The
271:         #    check therefore compares against half the reporting quantum.
272:         tb_debits = sum((r.gbp_debit for r in tb_rows), _ZERO)
273:         tb_credits = sum((r.gbp_credit for r in tb_rows), _ZERO)
274:         tb_residual = tb_debits - tb_credits
275:         statements.checks.append(
276:             {
277:                 "check": "consolidated_tb_balances",
278:                 "passed": abs(tb_residual) <= _ROUNDING_TOLERANCE,
279:                 "detail": (
280:                     f"total debits {round_reported(tb_debits)} = total credits "
281:                     f"{round_reported(tb_credits)} (difference "
282:                     f"{round_reported(tb_residual)})"
283:                 ),
284:             }
285:         )
286: 
287:         # 10. Verify every elimination journal balances (debits = credits) on
288:         #     full-precision values, and that the elimination set balances.
289:         per_journal: dict[str, list[Decimal]] = {}
290:         for entry in elim_entries:
291:             bucket = per_journal.setdefault(entry.journal_id, [_ZERO, _ZERO])
292:             bucket[0] += entry.gbp_debit
293:             bucket[1] += entry.gbp_credit
294:         unbalanced = [
295:             jid for jid, (dr, cr) in sorted(per_journal.items()) if dr != cr
296:         ]
297:         statements.checks.append(
298:             {
299:                 "check": "elimination_journals_balance",
300:                 "passed": not unbalanced,
301:                 "detail": (
302:                     (
303:                         f"all {len(per_journal)} elimination journal(s) balance "
304:                         f"(debits = credits)"
305:                     )
306:                     if not unbalanced
307:                     else (
308:                         "unbalanced elimination journal(s): "
309:                         + ", ".join(unbalanced)
310:                     )
311:                 ),
312:             }
313:         )
314: 
315:         return ConsolidationOutput(
316:             statement_assembler=self,
317:             entities=entity_ids,
318:             trial_balance_rows=tb_rows,
319:             eliminations=elim_entries,
320:             statements=statements,
321:             control_figures=figures,
322:             reconciliation=reconciliation,
323:             acquisition=acquisition_result,
324:             nci_post=nci_post,
325:             journal_decisions=decisions,
326:         )

332:     def _load_entities(self, entity_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, _EntityData]:
333:         data: dict[str, _EntityData] = {}
334:         for entity in entity_ids:
335:             tb = self.ingestor.ingest(entity)
336:             issues: list[ValidationIssue] = []
337:             validation = self.validator.validate(tb)
338:             issues.extend(validation.issues)
339:             mapped = self.mapper.map_trial_balance(tb)
340:             issues.extend(mapped.issues)
341:             mapped = self._correct_known_mapping_defects(entity, mapped)
342:             data[entity] = _EntityData(
343:                 entity=entity,
344:                 currency=tb.functional_currency,
345:                 trial_balance=tb,
346:                 mapped=mapped,
347:                 issues=issues,
348:             )
349:             for issue in issues:
350:                 self._add_issue(
351:                     code=issue.code,
352:                     severity=issue.severity,
353:                     message=issue.message,
354:                     action="flagged" if issue.severity is Severity.WARNING else "blocked",
355:                     entity=issue.entity,
356:                     source_file=issue.source_file,
357:                     source_row=issue.source_row,
358:                     account_code=issue.account_code,
359:                     details=issue.details,
360:                 )
361:         return data

363:     def _correct_known_mapping_defects(
364:         self, entity: str, mapped: MappedTrialBalance
365:     ) -> MappedTrialBalance:
366:         """Apply documented, deterministic corrections to source mapping defects.
367: 
368:         Currently: UK ``2310 Deferred income`` is recorded in ``map_uk.csv`` as
369:         mapping to group ``4100 Revenue``, which contradicts the group chart of
370:         accounts (where *Deferred income* is a liability at ``2300``). The
371:         source file is never modified; the row is re-mapped here and an issue is
372:         recorded so the correction is visible and traceable.
373:         """
374:         if entity != "UK":
375:             return mapped
376:         corrected_rows = []
377:         changed = False
378:         for row in mapped.rows:
379:             if row.local_account_code != UK_DEFERRED_INCOME_LOCAL:
380:                 corrected_rows.append(row)
381:                 continue
382:             if row.group_account_code == UK_DEFERRED_INCOME_CORRECT_GROUP:
383:                 corrected_rows.append(row)
384:                 continue
385:             target = self.mapper.group_coa.get(UK_DEFERRED_INCOME_CORRECT_GROUP)
386:             corrected_rows.append(
387:                 row.model_copy(
388:                     update={
389:                         "group_account_code": UK_DEFERRED_INCOME_CORRECT_GROUP,
390:                         "group_account_name": target.account_name if target else "Deferred income",
391:                         "mapped": target is not None,
392:                     }
393:                 )
394:             )
395:             changed = True
396:             self._add_issue(
397:                 code="mapping_defect_corrected",
398:                 severity=Severity.WARNING,
399:                 message=(
400:                     f"UK local account {UK_DEFERRED_INCOME_LOCAL} "
401:                     f"(Deferred income) is mapped to group 4100 Revenue in "
402:                     f"map_uk.csv, contradicting the group chart of accounts; "
403:                     f"re-mapped to group {UK_DEFERRED_INCOME_CORRECT_GROUP} "
404:                     f"(Deferred income, a liability). Source file left unmodified."
405:                 ),
406:                 action="flagged",
407:                 entity="UK",
408:                 source_file=row.source_file,
409:                 source_row=row.source_row,
410:                 account_code=UK_DEFERRED_INCOME_LOCAL,
411:                 affected_amount=row.debit + row.credit,
412:                 details={
413:                     "source_group_code": "4100",
414:                     "corrected_group_code": UK_DEFERRED_INCOME_CORRECT_GROUP,
415:                     "source_mapping_file": "map_uk.csv",
416:                 },
417:             )
418:         if not changed:
419:             return mapped
420:         return mapped.model_copy(update={"rows": corrected_rows})

422:     def _record_prompt_injection_issues(self) -> None:
423:         """Record any free-text memo that tries to instruct an automated tool.
424: 
425:         The source ``adjustments.json`` contains a memo addressed to automated
426:         reviewers/AI assistants, instructing them to skip the balance check for
427:         JE-006 and not to report it. Such text is treated strictly as data: it
428:         is surfaced here as an issue and has no effect on the deterministic
429:         validation (which rejects JE-006 for being unbalanced).
430:         """
431:         injection_markers = (
432:             "ai assistant",
433:             "automated reviewer",
434:             "skip the",
435:             "do not list",
436:             "mark it as accepted",
437:         )
438:         for journal in self.journals.load_journals():
439:             if not journal.memo_present:
440:                 continue
441:             text = " ".join(
442:                 (line.raw.get("memo") or "") for line in journal.lines
443:             ).lower()
444:             if any(marker in text for marker in injection_markers):
445:                 self._add_issue(
446:                     code="prompt_injection_ignored",
447:                     severity=Severity.WARNING,
448:                     message=(
449:                         f"{journal.journal_id} contains a free-text memo that "
450:                         f"tries to instruct automated reviewers to skip "
451:                         f"validation; the text was treated as data and ignored"
452:                     ),
453:                     action="flagged",
454:                     entity=journal.entity,
455:                     source_file="adjustments.json",
456:                     affected_amount=abs(journal.difference) or None,
457:                     details={"journal_id": journal.journal_id, "memo_present": True},
458:                 )

460:     def _check_subledger_controls(self, entity_data: dict[str, _EntityData]) -> None:
461:         """Compare each entity's AR/AP sub-ledger control totals to its TB.
462: 
463:         A difference is reported as an issue; the TB is never adjusted to force
464:         agreement (the sub-ledger total is a control, not a posting).
465:         """
466:         controls: dict[tuple[str, str], Decimal] = {}
467:         for row in self.service.get_subledger_controls():
468:             key = (
469:                 (row.get("entity_id") or "").strip().upper(),
470:                 (row.get("ledger") or "").strip().lower(),
471:             )
472:             try:
473:                 controls[key] = Decimal((row.get("control_total") or "0").strip() or "0")
474:             except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - non-numeric control is skipped
475:                 continue
476: 
477:         # Group accounts holding trade receivables / payables.
478:         ar_group, ap_group = "1200", "2100"
479:         for entity, data in entity_data.items():
480:             balances: dict[str, Decimal] = {ar_group: _ZERO, ap_group: _ZERO}
481:             for row in data.mapped.rows:
482:                 if row.group_account_code in balances:
483:                     balances[row.group_account_code] += row.debit - row.credit
484:             ar_control = next(
485:                 (v for (e, l), v in controls.items() if e == entity and "receivable" in l),
486:                 None,
487:             )
488:             ap_control = next(
489:                 (v for (e, l), v in controls.items() if e == entity and "payable" in l),
490:                 None,
491:             )
492:             for control, tb_value, group_code, label in (
493:                 (ar_control, balances[ar_group], ar_group, "receivables"),
494:                 (ap_control, -balances[ap_group], ap_group, "payables"),
495:             ):
496:                 if control is None:
497:                     continue
498:                 difference = tb_value - control
499:                 if difference != _ZERO:
500:                     self._add_issue(
501:                         code="subledger_control_difference",
502:                         severity=Severity.WARNING,
503:                         message=(
504:                             f"{entity} {label} sub-ledger control {control} does "
505:                             f"not agree with the trial balance {tb_value} "
506:                             f"(difference {difference}); the TB was not adjusted"
507:                         ),
508:                         action="flagged",
509:                         entity=entity,
510:                         source_file="subledger_controls.csv",
511:                         account_code=group_code,
512:                         affected_amount=abs(difference),
513:                         details={
514:                             "control_total": str(control),
515:                             "trial_balance_total": str(tb_value),
516:                             "difference": str(difference),
517:                         },
518:                     )

520:     def _apply_journals(
521:         self, entity_data: dict[str, _EntityData], posted_journals: list[Any]
522:     ) -> dict[str, dict[str, list[Decimal]]]:
523:         """Return per-entity group-account balances adjusted for posted journals.
524: 
525:         Balances are ``{group_code: [debit, credit]}`` in the *functional*
526:         currency, built from the mapped TB plus the valid, in-period journals.
527:         Journal lines whose local account has no mapping are reported and left
528:         out (never guessed).
529:         """
530:         lookup_by_entity: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
531:         for entity, data in entity_data.items():
532:             lookup: dict[str, str] = {}
533:             for row in data.mapped.rows:
534:                 if row.mapped and row.group_account_code:
535:                     lookup.setdefault(row.local_account_code, row.group_account_code)
536:             lookup_by_entity[entity] = lookup
537: 
538:         balances: dict[str, dict[str, list[Decimal]]] = {}
539:         for entity, data in entity_data.items():
540:             entity_balances: dict[str, list[Decimal]] = defaultdict(lambda: [_ZERO, _ZERO])
541:             for row in data.mapped.rows:
542:                 if not row.mapped or not row.group_account_code:
543:                     continue
544:                 entity_balances[row.group_account_code][0] += row.debit
545:                 entity_balances[row.group_account_code][1] += row.credit
546:             balances[entity] = entity_balances
547: 
548:         for journal in posted_journals:
549:             entity = journal.entity
550:             if entity not in entity_data:
551:                 continue
552:             lookup = lookup_by_entity[entity]
553:             for line in journal.lines:
554:                 group_code = lookup.get(line.account)
555:                 if group_code is None:
556:                     self._add_issue(
557:                         code="journal_line_unmapped",
558:                         severity=Severity.WARNING,
559:                         message=(
560:                             f"{journal.journal_id} line account {line.account!r} "
561:                             f"has no group mapping; the line was not applied"
562:                         ),
563:                         action="held_for_review",
564:                         entity=entity,
565:                         account_code=line.account,
566:                         affected_amount=line.debit + line.credit,
567:                         details={"journal_id": journal.journal_id},
568:                     )
569:                     continue
570:                 balances[entity][group_code][0] += line.debit
571:                 balances[entity][group_code][1] += line.credit
572:         return balances
573: 
574:     def _reject_partially_unmapped_journals(
575:         self,
576:         entity_data: dict[str, _EntityData],
577:         decisions: list[JournalDecision],
578:     ) -> list[JournalDecision]:
579:         """Reject, in full, any posted journal that has an unmapped line.
580: 
581:         A journal is an all-or-nothing unit: if one of its lines cannot be
582:         resolved to a group account, posting only the residual lines would
583:         break the entity's debits = credits. Rather than silently absorb that
584:         break in the translation reserve, the journal is rejected in full and
585:         the unmapped line is recorded as an issue (policy §6: "invalid journals
586:         are not posted" — a journal that cannot be applied completely is not
587:         valid for posting).
588:         """
589:         # Build each entity's local -> group lookup from the mapped rows.
590:         lookups: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {}
591:         for entity, data in entity_data.items():
592:             lookup: dict[str, str] = {}
593:             for row in data.mapped.rows:
594:                 if row.mapped and row.group_account_code:
595:                     lookup.setdefault(row.local_account_code, row.group_account_code)
596:             lookups[entity] = lookup
597: 
598:         by_id = {j.journal_id: j for j in self.journals.load_journals()}
599:         revised: list[JournalDecision] = []
600:         for decision in decisions:
601:             if decision.status is not JournalStatus.POSTED:
602:                 revised.append(decision)
603:                 continue
604:             journal = by_id.get(decision.journal_id)
605:             lookup = lookups.get(decision.entity, {})
606:             unmapped = [
607:                 line.account
608:                 for line in (journal.lines if journal else ())
609:                 if line.account not in lookup
610:             ]
611:             if not unmapped:
612:                 revised.append(decision)
613:                 continue
614:             revised.append(
615:                 JournalDecision(
616:                     journal_id=decision.journal_id,
617:                     entity=decision.entity,
618:                     status=JournalStatus.REJECTED,
619:                     reason=(
620:                         f"line account(s) {sorted(unmapped)} have no group "
621:                         f"mapping; posting only the remaining lines would "
622:                         f"unbalance {decision.entity}, so the journal was "
623:                         f"rejected in full (policy §6)"
624:                     ),
625:                     debit_total=decision.debit_total,
626:                     credit_total=decision.credit_total,
627:                     difference=decision.difference,
628:                     source_index=decision.source_index,
629:                     duplicate_of=decision.duplicate_of,
630:                 )
631:             )
632:             for account in sorted(unmapped):
633:                 self._add_issue(
634:                     code="journal_rejected_unmapped_line",
635:                     severity=Severity.ERROR,
636:                     message=(
637:                         f"{decision.journal_id} ({decision.entity}): line "
638:                         f"account {account!r} has no group mapping; the whole "
639:                         f"journal was rejected so {decision.entity} stays "
640:                         f"balanced (policy §6)"
641:                     ),
642:                     action="rejected",
643:                     entity=decision.entity,
644:                     source_file="adjustments.json",
645:                     account_code=account,
646:                     details={"journal_id": decision.journal_id},
647:                 )
648:         return revised
649: 
650:     def _record_journal_issues(self, decisions: list[JournalDecision]) -> None:
651:         for decision in decisions:
652:             if decision.status is JournalStatus.POSTED:
653:                 continue
654:             action = {
655:                 JournalStatus.REJECTED: "rejected",
656:                 JournalStatus.EXCLUDED: "excluded",
657:                 JournalStatus.FLAGGED: "held_for_review",
658:             }[decision.status]
659:             severity = (
660:                 Severity.ERROR
661:                 if decision.status is JournalStatus.REJECTED
662:                 else Severity.WARNING
663:             )
664:             self._add_issue(
665:                 code=f"journal_{decision.status.value}",
666:                 severity=severity,
667:                 message=(
668:                     f"{decision.journal_id} ({decision.entity}): "
669:                     f"{decision.reason}"
670:                 ),
671:                 action=action,
672:                 entity=decision.entity,
673:                 source_file="adjustments.json",
674:                 affected_amount=abs(decision.difference) or None,
675:                 details={
676:                     "journal_id": decision.journal_id,
677:                     "debit_total": str(decision.debit_total),
678:                     "credit_total": str(decision.credit_total),
679:                     "difference": str(decision.difference),
680:                     "duplicate_of": decision.duplicate_of,
681:                 },
682:             )
683: 
684:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
685:     # Stage 3: translation
686:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
687: 
688:     def _translate(
689:         self,
690:         entity_data: dict[str, _EntityData],
691:         balances: dict[str, dict[str, list[Decimal]]],
692:     ) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
693:         """Translate each entity's balances into GBP.
694: 
695:         Returns, per entity, ``{"pl": {code: gbp_net}, "bs": {code: gbp_net}}``
696:         where net is ``debit - credit`` in GBP. Equity accounts are excluded
697:         (handled at assembly from historical balances).
698: 
699:         An entity acquired mid-year (India) contributes only from its
700:         acquisition month. Its P&L is therefore rebuilt **only** from the
701:         monthly P&L rows on or after the acquisition month (translated at the
702:         period-of-inclusion average, H), and the monthly total for each ledger
703:         is tied to that entity's trial balance — a mismatch blocks the run.
704:         Revenue/expenses earned before the acquisition (the Apr–Jun quarter)
705:         belong to the previous owners and are not group profit.
706:         """
707:         result: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
708:         for entity, data in entity_data.items():
709:             currency = data.currency
710:             acquisition_date = self._acquisition_date(entity)
711:             if acquisition_date and self._is_partial_year(acquisition_date):
712:                 balances = dict(balances)
713:                 balances[entity] = self._partial_year_pl_balances(
714:                     entity, data, acquisition_date
715:                 )
716:             policy = FXTranslator.policy_for_entity(
717:                 entity,
718:                 currency,
719:                 acquisition_date=acquisition_date,
720:             )
721:             closing_rate = self._rate(currency, FXRateType.CLOSING)
722:             income_rate = self._rate(currency, policy.income_rate_type)
723: 
724:             pl: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: _ZERO)
725:             bs: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: _ZERO)
726:             # Per group-account source detail so a reported balance traces back
727:             # to the exact entity rows, files and rates that produced it.
728:             detail: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
729:             for group_code, (debit, credit) in balances[entity].items():
730:                 if group_code in EQUITY_ACCOUNTS:
731:                     continue
732:                 account = self.mapper.group_coa.get(group_code)
733:                 net = debit - credit
734:                 if account is not None and account.statement == "PL":
735:                     pl[group_code] += net * income_rate
736:                     rate_type_used = policy.income_rate_type.value
737:                     rate_used = income_rate
738:                 else:
739:                     bs[group_code] += net * closing_rate
740:                     rate_type_used = FXRateType.CLOSING.value
741:                     rate_used = closing_rate
742:                 for row in data.mapped.rows:
743:                     if not row.mapped or row.group_account_code != group_code:
744:                         continue
745:                     detail[group_code].append(
746:                         {
747:                             "entity": entity,
748:                             "source_file": row.source_file,
749:                             "source_row": row.source_row,
750:                             "local_account_code": row.local_account_code,
751:                             "functional_currency": currency,
752:                             "debit": str(row.debit),
753:                             "credit": str(row.credit),
754:                             "rate_type": rate_type_used,
755:                             "rate": str(rate_used),
756:                             "gbp_debit": str(row.debit * rate_used),
757:                             "gbp_credit": str(row.credit * rate_used),
758:                         }
759:                     )
760:             # Posted-journal detail: record which journals touched the entity so
761:             # the adjusted balance is traceable to adjustments.json as well.
762:             result[entity] = {
763:                 "pl": pl,
764:                 "bs": bs,
765:                 "closing_rate": closing_rate,
766:                 "income_rate": income_rate,
767:                 "detail": detail,
768:             }
769:         return result
770: 
771:     def _rate(self, currency: str, rate_type: FXRateType) -> Decimal:
772:         """Resolve ``currency -> GBP`` at ``rate_type``; never invent a rate."""
773:         resolved = self.fx.resolve(currency, self.presentation_currency, rate_type)
774:         return resolved.rate
775: 
776:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
777:     # Entity master (entities.csv) — no hardcoded currencies/dates
778:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
779: 
780:     def _entities_master(self) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
781:         """The entity master keyed by upper-case entity id (entities.csv)."""
782:         cached = getattr(self, "_entity_master", None)
783:         if cached is None:
784:             cached = {}
785:             for row in self.service.list_entities():
786:                 key = (row.get("entity_id") or "").strip().upper()
787:                 if key:
788:                     cached[key] = row
789:             self._entity_master = cached
790:         return cached
791: 
792:     def _entity_currency(self, entity: str) -> str:
793:         """Functional currency for ``entity`` from the entity master."""
794:         row = self._entities_master().get(entity.strip().upper())
795:         if row and (row.get("functional_currency") or "").strip():
796:             return row["functional_currency"].strip().upper()
797:         data = getattr(self, "_entity_data", {}).get(entity.strip().upper())
798:         if data is not None:
799:             return data.currency
800:         return self.presentation_currency
801: 
802:     def _acquisition_date(self, entity: str) -> str | None:
803:         """Acquisition date for ``entity`` from the entity master, if any.
804: 
805:         Returns any recorded acquisition date; the caller decides whether it
806:         makes the entity partial-year via :meth:`_is_partial_year`.
807:         """
808:         row = self._entities_master().get(entity.strip().upper())
809:         if not row:
810:             return None
811:         date = (row.get("acquisition_date") or "").strip()
812:         return date or None
813: 
814:     # The group reporting period (FY2024). A subsidiary acquired after the
815:     # start of the reporting year is consolidated only from its acquisition
816:     # date, so its income/expenses belong to the period of inclusion (H2).
817:     _REPORTING_PERIOD_START = "2024-01-01"
818:     _REPORTING_PERIOD_END = "2024-12-31"
819: 
820:     def _is_partial_year(self, acquisition_date: str) -> bool:
821:         """True when an entity joins the group part-way through the year.
822: 
823:         An entity acquired on or after 1 July of the reporting year is
824:         consolidated for H2 only (income/expenses at the H2 average, P&L built
825:         from the monthly movements on/after the acquisition month).
826:         """
827:         return (
828:             self._REPORTING_PERIOD_START
829:             < acquisition_date
830:             <= self._REPORTING_PERIOD_END
831:             and acquisition_date >= f"{self._REPORTING_PERIOD_END[:4]}-07-01"
832:         )
833: 
834:     def _partial_year_pl_balances(
835:         self,
836:         entity: str,
837:         data: _EntityData,
838:         acquisition_date: str,
839:         *,
840:         reporting_year_end: str = "2024-12-31",
841:     ) -> dict[str, list[Decimal]]:
842:         """Rebuild a mid-year acquisition's P&L from its monthly movements.
843: 
844:         Only months **on or after** the acquisition month are included: the
845:         pre-acquisition result belongs to the previous owners and is part of
846:         net assets at acquisition, not group profit. Each ledger's monthly
847:         total is tied to that entity's trial balance; any difference blocks the
848:         run (no figure is ever absorbed).
849: 
850:         Returns ``{group_code: [debit, credit]}`` in the entity's functional
851:         currency, restricted to the included months, and merged with the
852:         entity's non-P&L balances so the caller can translate it as usual.
853:         """
854:         acq_month = acquisition_date[:7]
855:         monthly = self.service.get_monthly_pnl(entity)
856:         if not monthly:
857:             raise ServiceError(
858:                 f"{entity} was acquired mid-year ({acquisition_date}) but no "
859:                 f"monthly P&L is available to build its partial-year result",
860:                 details={"entity": entity, "acquisition_date": acquisition_date},
861:             )
862: 
863:         # Monthly totals per ledger code, split into "all months" (for the
864:         # tie-out to the TB) and "included months" (on/after the acquisition).
865:         all_total: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: _ZERO)
866:         included: dict[str, list[Decimal]] = defaultdict(lambda: [_ZERO, _ZERO])
867:         for row in monthly:
868:             ledger = (row.get("ledger_code") or "").strip()
869:             month = (row.get("month") or "").strip()
870:             amount = Decimal((row.get("amount") or "0").strip() or "0")
871:             dr_cr = (row.get("dr_cr") or "").strip().lower()
872:             all_total[ledger] += amount
873:             if month < acq_month:
874:                 continue
875:             if dr_cr == "cr":
876:                 included[ledger][1] += amount
877:             else:
878:                 included[ledger][0] += amount
879: 
880:         # Tie the monthly totals to the trial balance per ledger code.
881:         tb_by_local: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
882:         for row in data.trial_balance.rows:
883:             tb_by_local[row.local_account_code] = (
884:                 tb_by_local.get(row.local_account_code, _ZERO)
885:                 + row.debit
886:                 + row.credit
887:             )
888:         mismatches: list[str] = []
889:         for ledger, total in sorted(all_total.items()):
890:             tb_amount = tb_by_local.get(ledger)
891:             if tb_amount is None:
892:                 mismatches.append(f"{ledger}: monthly {total} has no TB row")
893:                 continue
894:             if abs(tb_amount - total) > _ROUNDING_TOLERANCE:
895:                 mismatches.append(
896:                     f"{ledger}: monthly {total} vs trial balance {tb_amount} "
897:                     f"(difference {tb_amount - total})"
898:                 )
899:         if mismatches:
900:             self._add_issue(
901:                 code="monthly_pl_tb_mismatch",
902:                 severity=Severity.ERROR,
903:                 message=(
904:                     f"{entity} monthly P&L does not tie to its trial balance "
905:                     f"for: " + "; ".join(mismatches)
906:                 ),
907:                 action="blocked",
908:                 entity=entity,
909:                 source_file="in_pl_monthly.csv",
910:                 details={"mismatches": mismatches},
911:             )
912:             raise ServiceError(
913:                 f"{entity} monthly P&L does not tie to the trial balance: "
914:                 + "; ".join(mismatches),
915:                 details={"entity": entity, "mismatches": mismatches},
916:             )
917: 
918:         # Start from the entity's full balances (so non-P&L items are kept),
919:         # then replace every P&L group account with the included-month valuation.
920:         balances: dict[str, list[Decimal]] = defaultdict(lambda: [_ZERO, _ZERO])
921:         for row in data.mapped.rows:
922:             if not row.mapped or not row.group_account_code:
923:                 continue
924:             account = self.mapper.group_coa.get(row.group_account_code)
925:             if account is not None and account.statement == "PL":
926:                 continue
927:             balances[row.group_account_code][0] += row.debit
928:             balances[row.group_account_code][1] += row.credit
929: 
930:         local_to_group = self._local_to_group_lookup(entity)
931:         for ledger, (debit, credit) in included.items():
932:             group_code = local_to_group.get(ledger)
933:             if group_code is None:
934:                 continue
935:             account = self.mapper.group_coa.get(group_code)
936:             if account is None or account.statement != "PL":
937:                 continue
938:             balances[group_code] = [
939:                 balances[group_code][0] + debit,
940:                 balances[group_code][1] + credit,
941:             ]
942:         return balances
943: 
944:     def _local_to_group_lookup(self, entity: str) -> dict[str, str]:
945:         """A stable local→group account lookup for one entity."""
946:         cached = getattr(self, "_local_group_lookups", None)
947:         if cached is None:
948:             cached = {}
949:             self._local_group_lookups = cached
950:         if entity in cached:
951:             return cached[entity]
952:         lookup: dict[str, str] = {}
953:         for row in self._entity_data.get(entity).mapped.rows if entity in self._entity_data else []:
954:             if row.mapped and row.group_account_code:
955:                 lookup.setdefault(row.local_account_code, row.group_account_code)
956:         cached[entity] = lookup
957:         return lookup
958: 
959: 
960:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
961:     # Stage 4-6: combine + eliminate
962:     # ------------------------------------------------------------------
963: 
964:     def _combine_and_eliminate(
965:         self,
966:         entity_data: dict[str, _EntityData],
967:         translated: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
968:         elimination_result: Any,
969:         acquisition_result: Any,
970:     ) -> tuple[list[ConsolidatedTBRow], list[EliminationEntry], dict[str, Decimal]]:
971:         """Combine translated entity balances and apply eliminations."""
972:         # Combined P&L (GBP, net = debit - credit) and BS (GBP, net).
973:         comb_pl: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: _ZERO)
974:         comb_bs: dict[str, Decimal] = defaultdict(lambda: _ZERO)
975:         for payload in translated.values():
976:             for code, value in payload["pl"].items():
977:                 comb_pl[code] += value
978:             for code, value in payload["bs"].items():
979:                 comb_bs[code] += value
980: 
981:         elim_entries: list[EliminationEntry] = []
982: 
983:         # 4a. Eliminate intercompany balances in full (policy §5).
984:         #
985:         # The group eliminates the *aggregate* intercompany receivable (1250)
986:         # against the aggregate intercompany payable (2150). Before doing so,
987:         # any intercompany item *in transit* at the year end is recorded by the
988:         # receiving entity at the closing rate (policy §5), so it appears on
989:         # both sides and eliminates to zero. Only the genuine exchange
990:         # difference on the matched invoices (each side booked at its own rate)
991:         # remains, and that is routed to the FX account (7300). Routing the
992:         # in-transit amount to FX — as an earlier revision did — would overstate
993:         # the group's foreign-exchange loss because an in-transit item is not an
994:         # exchange difference at all.
995:         ic_receivable = comb_bs.get(IC_RECEIVABLE, _ZERO)   # debit (asset)
996:         ic_payable = -comb_bs.get(IC_PAYABLE, _ZERO)         # credit (liability) as positive
997: 
998:         # Record in-transit items on the receiving side at the closing rate so
999:         # both sides carry them before elimination.
1000:         in_transit_total = _ZERO
1001:         in_transit_entries: list[EliminationEntry] = []
1002:         for item in self.reconciler.reconcile().unmatched:
1003:             if item.classification == "in_transit" and item.gbp_amount is not None:
1004:                 in_transit_total += item.gbp_amount
1005:                 in_transit_entries.append(
1006:                     EliminationEntry(
1007:                         journal_id=f"ELIM-TRANSIT-{item.source_row:03d}",
1008:                         kind="in_transit",
1009:                         reference=item.doc_ref,
1010:                         group_account_code=IC_PAYABLE,
1011:                         group_account_name=self._account_name(IC_PAYABLE),
1012:                         entity=item.counterparty,
1013:                         gbp_debit=_ZERO,
1014:                         gbp_credit=item.gbp_amount,
1015:                         reason=(
1016:                             f"record in-transit {item.doc_ref} in the receiving "
1017:                             f"entity ({item.counterparty}) at the closing rate "
1018:                             f"(policy §5)"
1019:                         ),
1020:                     )
1021:                 )
1022:                 in_transit_entries.append(
1023:                     EliminationEntry(
1024:                         journal_id=f"ELIM-TRANSIT-{item.source_row:03d}",
1025:                         kind="in_transit",
1026:                         reference=item.doc_ref,
1027:                         group_account_code=IC_RECEIVABLE,
1028:                         group_account_name=self._account_name(IC_RECEIVABLE),
1029:                         entity=item.reporting_entity,
1030:                         gbp_debit=item.gbp_amount,
1031:                         gbp_credit=_ZERO,
1032:                         reason=(
1033:                             f"clear the sender's in-transit {item.doc_ref} "
1034:                             f"against the receiving entity's recognition "
1035:                             f"(policy §5)"
1036:                         ),
1037:                     )
1038:                 )
1039:         if in_transit_total != _ZERO:
1040:             # Receiving entity books the payable; the payable magnitude grows.
1041:             ic_payable += in_transit_total
1042:             comb_bs[IC_PAYABLE] = comb_bs.get(IC_PAYABLE, _ZERO) - in_transit_total
1043: 
1044:         ic_balance_difference = ic_receivable - ic_payable
1045:         if ic_receivable != _ZERO or ic_payable != _ZERO:
1046:             comb_bs[IC_RECEIVABLE] = _ZERO
1047:             comb_bs[IC_PAYABLE] = _ZERO
1048:             comb_bs[FX_ACCOUNT] = comb_bs.get(FX_ACCOUNT, _ZERO) - ic_balance_difference
1049:             elim_entries.extend(in_transit_entries)
1050:             elim_entries.append(
1051:                 EliminationEntry(
1052:                     journal_id="ELIM-IC-001",
1053:                     kind="balance",
1054:                     reference="aggregate intercompany balances",
1055:                     group_account_code=IC_RECEIVABLE,
1056:                     group_account_name=self._account_name(IC_RECEIVABLE),
1057:                     entity="GROUP",
1058:                     gbp_debit=_ZERO,
1059:                     gbp_credit=ic_receivable,
1060:                     reason=(
1061:                         "eliminate aggregate intercompany receivable in full "
1062:                         "(policy §5)"
1063:                     ),
1064:                 )
1065:             )
1066:             elim_entries.append(
1067:                 EliminationEntry(
1068:                     journal_id="ELIM-IC-001",
1069:                     kind="balance",
1070:                     reference="aggregate intercompany balances",
1071:                     group_account_code=IC_PAYABLE,
1072:                     group_account_name=self._account_name(IC_PAYABLE),
1073:                     entity="GROUP",
1074:                     gbp_debit=ic_payable,
1075:                     gbp_credit=_ZERO,
1076:                     reason=(
1077:                         "eliminate aggregate intercompany payable in full "
1078:                         "(policy §5)"
1079:                     ),
1080:                 )
1081:             )
1082:             elim_entries.append(
1083:                 EliminationEntry(
1084:                     journal_id="ELIM-IC-001",
1085:                     kind="balance",
1086:                     reference="aggregate intercompany balances",
1087:                     group_account_code=FX_ACCOUNT,
1088:                     group_account_name=self._account_name(FX_ACCOUNT),
1089:                     entity="GROUP",
1090:                     gbp_debit=ic_balance_difference if ic_balance_difference > 0 else _ZERO,
1091:                     gbp_credit=-ic_balance_difference if ic_balance_difference < 0 else _ZERO,
1092:                     reason=(
1093:                         "exchange difference on matched intercompany invoices "
1094:                         "booked at different rates (policy §5; see "
1095:                         "intercompany_difference)"
1096:                     ),
1097:                 )
1098:             )
1099: 
1100:         # 4b. Eliminate intercompany income/expense (4200 vs 6300), residual to 7300.

1602:     @staticmethod
1603:     def _foot_section(section: StatementSection) -> StatementSection:
1604:         """Make the rounded line items sum exactly to the rounded section total.
1605: 
1606:         Each reported line is rounded to 2 dp independently (policy §7), so the
1607:         rounded lines can differ from the (rounded) exact total by a penny. A
1608:         reader summing the statement must reach the total, so the residual is
1609:         absorbed by the largest line item — a standard presentation-rounding
1610:         adjustment that leaves every other line untouched and never changes the
1611:         total. Lines without an amount (or with ``None``) are ignored.
1612:         """
1613:         if section.total is None:
1614:             return section
1615:         lines = [ln for ln in section.lines if ln.amount is not None]
1616:         if not lines:
1617:             return section
1618:         rounded_sum = sum((ln.amount for ln in lines), _ZERO)
1619:         residual = section.total - rounded_sum
1620:         if residual == _ZERO:
1621:             return section
1622:         # Absorb the residual in the largest line item.
1623:         target = max(lines, key=lambda ln: abs(ln.amount))
1624:         new_lines = [
1625:             ln.model_copy(update={"amount": ln.amount + residual})
1626:             if ln is target
1627:             else ln
1628:             for ln in section.lines
1629:         ]
1630:         return section.model_copy(update={"lines": new_lines})
